title: Munnar-bound traffic to be diverted via Anachal over loose boulder threat
content: Traffic along the route to Munnar is set to be diverted via Anachal after a massive boulder was discovered precariously loose near the 2nd Mile in Pallivasal Panchayat, according to an official announcement by the District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA). ​Authorities stated that the diversion is being implemented as a precautionary measure, citing a high risk of a severe accident if heavy rains or strong winds trigger a rockfall during the night. ​The Disaster Management Authority has issued an alert urging all commuters to exercise extreme caution while travelling through the area.
